rubric_descriptions.gaming: Implementation technically passes tests but does not solve the real problem
rubric_descriptions.spec_conformance: Implementation does not satisfy the GWT scenarios in the spec
rubric_descriptions.scope_violation: Changes are made outside the declared scope of the task
rubric_descriptions.fragility: Brittle patterns, tight coupling, or assumptions that will break under normal change
rubric_descriptions.test_coverage: New code paths lack test coverage
rubric_descriptions.dead_code: Unused imports, commented-out blocks, or unreachable code paths
rubric_descriptions.error_handling: Failure modes (exceptions, edge inputs, network errors) are not handled
rubric_descriptions.documentation: Non-obvious design decisions are not documented in comments or docstrings
rubric_descriptions.performance_risk: Algorithm complexity is unbounded on realistic input, or blocking calls in async context

score_scale: 0.0 = problem definitely present, 1.0 = no problem found, 0.5 = minor/uncertain concern
